name: timplio
description: Suivi local des temps et de la rentabilité des affaires
author: Timplio

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/prepare-electron.mjs && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/prepare-electron.mjs && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/prepare-electron.mjs && vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:dir: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/prepare-electron.mjs && vite build && electron-builder --dir
